create.name: Bradford Keeney
create.bio:
Bradford Keeney teaches ecstatic spirituality together with his wife, Hillary Keeney, under the name Sacred Ecstatics. His own path began with an unplanned spiritual awakening at nineteen, while he was improvising at the piano. He went on to a doctorate in cybernetics, studied with Gregory Bateson and Heinz von Foerster, and spent years as a professor and family therapy researcher before leaving academia to travel among shamans and healers. The Kalahari Bushmen accepted him as a healer, and he also learned from teachers in Japan, Bali, Brazil and the Caribbean. Hillary, who practised Zen at the Zen Center of Los Angeles, met him at the California Institute of Integral Studies.

Since 2014 the couple have worked on Sacred Ecstatics full time. At its heart is what they call Ecstatic Sound Movement, a practice of spontaneous movement guided by music, which they use to raise strong spiritual feeling and then bring it back into daily life. They run an online Guild that meets from October to July, offer private sessions and hold a yearly gathering, with Brad improvising at the keyboard. Their books include the Climbing the Rope to God series, Way of the Bushman and Bushman Shaman.

videos.title: Working with Seiki, Non-Subtle Life Force Energy
Milking the life force - the daily seiki movement exercise

books.title: Sacred Ecstatics: The Recipe for Setting Your Soul on Fire
books.author: Bradford Keeney, Hillary Keeney
books.description: The Keeneys' core statement of their approach, explaining how they work with music, movement and strong feeling to stir the spirit and then carry it into everyday life.

books.title: Climbing the Rope to God: Mystical Testimony and Teaching, Volume I
books.author: Bradford Keeney, Hillary Keeney
books.description: First of three volumes gathering the couple's visionary accounts and the teaching that grew out of them, with records of experiments from their Guild.

books.title: Climbing the Rope to God: Mystical Testimony and Teaching, Volume II
books.author: Bradford Keeney, Hillary Keeney
books.description: The second volume of the series, continuing the record of the Keeneys' dreams and visions and the work of their Guild members.

books.title: Climbing the Rope to God: Mystical Testimony and Teaching, Volume III
books.author: Bradford Keeney, Hillary Keeney
books.description: The closing volume of the series, bringing the story of their visionary teaching and Guild seasons up to its publication in 2021.

books.title: The Spiritual Engineering of Sacred Ecstasy
books.author: Bradford Keeney, Hillary Keeney
books.description: The third of their foundational books, looking at how sound, rhythm and movement are arranged to open people to ecstatic experience.

books.title: Way of the Bushman
books.author: Bradford Keeney, Hillary Keeney
books.description: An account of the spiritual life of the Kalahari Bushmen, drawing on Brad's years of living and dancing with their healers.

books.title: Bushman Shaman: Awakening the Spirit through Ecstatic Dance
books.author: Bradford Keeney
books.description: Brad's own story of being taken in by Kalahari healers, and what their dance and trembling practices taught him about the spirit.

books.title: The Bushman Way of Tracking God
books.author: Bradford Keeney
books.description: A book of teachings passed on to him by Bushman elders, on following the pull of the divine in ordinary life.

books.title: The Flying Drum: The Mojo Doctor's Guide to Creating Magic in Your Life
books.author: Bradford Keeney
books.description: Playful stories and exercises from his travels among healers, meant to bring a sense of mystery and improvisation into everyday life.

books.title: Seiki Jutsu: The Practice of Non-Subtle Energy Medicine
books.author: Bradford Keeney, Hillary Keeney
books.description: The Keeneys describe the Japanese seiki practice they learned from Ikuko Osumi Sensei, in which vital energy is passed from person to person.

courses.title: The Sacred Ecstatics Guild
courses.description: Their online community, meeting in a season that runs each year from October to July. Members practise Ecstatic Sound Movement at home and in group meetings and try out small spiritual interventions in daily life.

courses.title: The Sacred Ecstatics Reset
courses.description: Private sessions with Brad and Hillary that use conversation, sound and movement rather than analysis, ending with practical next steps to take home.

courses.title: Sacred Ecstatics Fest in Budapest
courses.description: A week-long gathering at the Turbina Cultural Center in Budapest, in two parts: a three-day Soul Cookout of music, movement and ceremony, then a three-day Healing Heart Tune-Up. Either part can be booked alone.

free_resources.title: Catching a Numi: A Little Guide to the Pinnacle Spiritual Experience
free_resources.description: A short illustrated book by Hillary Keeney, free to download, on the peak moments of spiritual experience that Sacred Ecstatics aims for.

free_resources.title: The Pinnacle Prayer Book
free_resources.description: Hillary Keeney's small illustrated book of prayers, offered as a free epub download.
